newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line splits stock two-for-one.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line splits stock two-for-one.

text.p: Finish Line Inc, a specialty retailer, said Monday its directors approved a two-for-one stock split payable November 15, record October 18.

In order to implement the stock split, stockholders holding more than a majority of the votes of class A and class B common stock said they intend to approve an increase in the number of authorized shares to 43 million from 33 million, according to the company.

The 43 million shares include 30 million shares of class A stock, 12 million shares of class B stock, and one million shares of preferred stock. The 33 million shares include 20 million shares of class A stock, 12 million shares of class B stock, and one million shares of preferred stock.

The stock split should increase liquidity in the company's stock by making the stock price range attractive to a wider range of investors, said Alan Cohen, Finish Line chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Finish Line A shares closed at 46 on September 27.
Finish Line currently operates 238 stores in 26 states, principally in the Midwest, South and Southeast.
